svg.aria-label: 0.254: An LLM is surest of its fluent fakes, so its own confidence catches hallucinations worse than a coin flip. A hidden-state probe: 0.988. (halluscope · AUROC on HaluEval, n = 4,000). 6 / 6: Every published backdoor detector I tested scores below chance against WaNet. Following any of them is worse than guessing. (deadbolt · 102-model zoo, 540 blind scans). ~2×: The diffusion LM I forked had a loss that still went down, just toward twice the true entropy. One wrong denominator. (nanoDLM · mask.sum() → B·T). 0.4 ms: The cost of putting spend caps, rate limits, argument guards, and a hash-chained audit log in front of every agent tool call. (Bastion · vs. a ~2.5 ms stdio round trip).

svg.text: LAB NOTEBOOK · RESULTS I DIDN’T EXPECT

g.text: An LLM is surest of its fluent fakes, so its own confidence catches
hallucinations worse than a coin flip. A hidden-state probe: 0.988.
Every published backdoor detector I tested scores below chance against
WaNet. Following any of them is worse than guessing.
The diffusion LM I forked had a loss that still went down, just toward twice
the true entropy. One wrong denominator.
The cost of putting spend caps, rate limits, argument guards, and a
hash-chained audit log in front of every agent tool call.
Bastion · vs. a ~2.5 ms stdio round trip
